Меньше — больше символов и деталей карти: Smaller values add characters and image detail but increase workload. Larger values make letters bigger and the image coarser. Start with 14–18.
Скорость светящихся потоков. 1 — обычная: Speed of the glowing streams. 1 is the normal speed. The letters themselves are controlled separately by Character movement and Character speed.
Усиливает свечение и читаемость картинки: Boosts the glow and image visibility. Reduce it if bright areas merge together. 1 is the effect's original brightness.
Усиливает разницу между светлыми и тёмны: Increases the difference between light and dark image areas. High values emphasize the silhouette but may lose midtones. 1 is the original contrast.
Куда движутся светящиеся головки и хвост: Direction of the rain's glowing heads and tails. Choose Down for the film effect. The characters' own direction is configured separately.
Перемещает сам рисунок из букв. «Неподви: Moves the character pattern itself. Stationary stops its horizontal and vertical drift while light streams keep moving. Choose Down for falling letters.
За секунду буквы сдвигаются на выбранное: How many cells the letters move each second. 0 stops their drift in any direction. This setting applies when Character movement is not Stationary.
Длина светящегося следа за головкой пото: Length of the glowing trail behind a stream head, in character cells. Short tails produce separate flashes; long tails produce extended streaks.
Доля активных потоков: 1 — максимально г: Proportion of active streams: 1 is the densest rain, 0.5 is about half. Reduce it if rain hides image details.
Позволяет потокам идти с разной скорость: Lets streams move at different speeds for less uniform rain. Turn it off for a consistent pace.
«Постоянно читается» — рисунок виден сра: Always visible shows the image immediately. Gradually revealed builds it behind the rain and keeps it visible. Appears and dissolves repeats the cycle.
Длительность полного повторения сборки и: Duration of a complete reveal-and-dissolve cycle. Only applies to Appears and dissolves. More seconds means a slower cycle.
«Выбранный цвет» использует цвет символо: Selected color uses the character color. Original image colors preserves the image's hues. Gradient blends the character and head colors from top to bottom. Rainbow changes hues over time.
Основной цвет букв в одноцветном режиме: Main letter color in monochrome mode and the start of the gradient. Choose green for a classic Matrix effect.
Цвет тёмных участков между символами. Чё: Color of dark areas between characters. A black background increases contrast for the classic Matrix appearance.
Цвет ярких головок дождя и конец градиен: Color of the bright rain heads and the end of the gradient. A light shade separates the leading character from its tail.
Верхняя желаемая частота анимации. 20–30: Desired maximum animation rate. 20–30 FPS is usually enough for wallpaper. Economy mode, battery limits and automatic CPU adjustment may lower the actual FPS.
Дополнительный потолок FPS при разряде б: Additional FPS ceiling while the battery is discharging. Requires economy mode; does not apply on AC power.
Ограничивает анимацию до 12 FPS. При раб: Limits animation to 12 FPS. On battery, FPS on battery is also considered. Turn this off and set the frame rate for smoother motion.
Приостанавливает отрисовку, если рабочая: Pauses rendering when windows completely cover the monitor's work area. Motion resumes when the desktop is visible again.
Останавливает отрисовку на время блокиро: Stops rendering while the session is locked to avoid spending resources on invisible wallpaper.
Автоматический режим использует GPU/Open: Automatic mode uses GPU/OpenGL and falls back to CPU/Cairo when unavailable. GPU mode also has a CPU fallback. Select CPU to investigate graphics driver problems.
Целевая загрузка отрисовки, если включён: Target rendering load when automatic FPS adjustment is enabled. 100% means one logical CPU thread, not the whole processor. This is a target, not a hard quota; GPU and compositor usage are excluded.
Понижает FPS, когда отрисовка превышает: Lowers FPS when rendering exceeds the CPU target and gradually raises it when resources are available. A low target can noticeably reduce smoothness. The CPU target is unused when this is off.
Усиливает сохранение деталей в области,: Preserves more detail inside the area painted in Crop and select subject. 0 disables the enhancement. It has no visible effect without a painted subject mask.
1 — основной рисунок. 2 добавляет мелкие: 1 is the main image. 2 adds small distant characters; 3 also adds large nearby ones. Extra layers add depth and increase workload.
Выраженность дополнительных ближнего и д: Strength of the extra near and far layers. Has no visible effect with only one layer.
Длительность появления нового оформления: How long the new appearance takes to appear when applied. 0 is immediate; higher values give a gentler fade-in.
Анализирует звук, который играет в систе: Analyzes audio playing on the system. Volume affects brightness and bass affects speed. The microphone is not used. Play music or a video to see a response.
Усиление реакции на тихий звук. Увеличьт: Amplifies the response to quiet audio. Increase it if music is playing but the effect barely changes. Requires the audio reaction to be enabled.
Максимальная выраженность реакции на зву: Maximum audio reaction strength: 0 removes it and 0.30 is the maximum. Start with 0.05–0.10 for calm wallpaper.
Приближает картинку внутри экрана. 1 зап: Zooms into the image. 1 fills the frame; differing aspect ratios may crop the edges. After zooming, move the image to choose the visible area.
Сдвигает кадр влево или вправо в предела: Moves the crop left or right within the cropped edges. 0 centers it. If the full image width fits the frame, movement has no visible effect.
Сдвигает кадр вверх или вниз в пределах: Moves the crop up or down within the cropped edges. 0 centers it. If the full image height fits the frame, movement has no visible effect.
Радиус кисти для выделения или стирания: Brush radius for painting or erasing the subject mask. Use a large brush for the silhouette and a small one for edges and fine details.
Длина экспортируемого ролика: от 2 до 60: Length of the exported clip, from 2 to 60 seconds. For cyclic reveal, the full cycle is fitted to the video duration.
Частота кадров готового MP4, независимо: Frame rate of the finished MP4, independent of desktop economy settings. More FPS makes a smoother clip but increases export time and file size.
Разрешение готового MP4. 720p подходит д: Resolution of the finished MP4. 720p is useful for a quick sample; 1080p gives more detail. Higher resolution takes longer to export.
1. Во вкладке «Оформление» выберите карт:
1. Choose an image in the Appearance tab. The preview on the right updates automatically.

2. Click the Matrix button at the top for the ready-made effect, or configure characters, colors and motion yourself.

3. Click Apply to desktop. Until then, appearance changes are shown only in the preview.

Hover over a setting to read its tooltip. Press F1 or click Guide to search all parameters. For example, search for horizontal, battery, CPU or SQL.

Closing the editor leaves the wallpaper running. Use the system tray icon to open settings or pause the wallpaper.
Картинка превращается в рисунок из симво:
The image is recreated with characters. Small letters show more detail; large letters emphasize the rain itself. Brightness and contrast help make the silhouette readable.

You can enter your own text in the character field. Individual characters mode uses up to 256 different symbols; duplicates and whitespace are removed. In words and phrases mode, put each phrase on a separate line: up to 128 lines of 512 characters each, and up to 256 different symbols in total. Words, SQL queries and your own expressions all work.

Save custom set stores the text and its mode. Save the complete appearance, including the image and colors, as a profile.

A palette sets three colors. Their use depends on Color mode in Effects and system. Choose Original image colors to preserve a photo's hues.

Number of layers and Layer depth are in the Tools tab.
Готовый режим «Матрица» в верхней панели:
The ready-made Matrix mode in the top bar sets green falling characters, bright heads, katakana and a gradual image reveal. Your chosen image, crop and resource limits are kept. Click Apply to install the effect.

Matrix (film) in the character set list changes only the alphabet. The top Matrix button changes the full effect appearance.

Stream direction controls the glowing heads and tails. Character movement controls the letters themselves. To remove horizontal drift, choose Stationary, or Down for falling letters. Character speed 0 also fixes their positions.

Choose Gradually revealed to build the image behind the rain and keep it visible. For repetition, choose Appears and dissolves and adjust the reveal period.

Pause freezes all desktop animation immediately, without Apply. Desktop files remain usable; the preview is controlled separately.
Откройте «Кадрирование и выделение…» во:
Open Crop and select subject in Appearance. The image fills the screen, cropping the edges if the aspect ratios differ. The original file is unchanged.

Choose Move image and drag with the mouse. Use the wheel to zoom. The sliders let you set the zoom and position precisely.

Choose Paint subject mask and paint over the main subject. Red shows the mask only in the editor. Erase mask removes part of it, Undo stroke restores the previous mask, and Clear removes the entire mask. Reset crop restores the centered position and zoom.

Click Save, then adjust Preserve subject detail in Tools. Higher values preserve more detail in the painted area. Then apply the appearance to the desktop.

The painted subject mask and the mouse selection rectangle on the desktop are separate features. For the rectangle, see Desktop files and selection.
Файлы, папки и ссылки остаются над анима:
Files, folders and links remain above the animation. You can open them, move them, use their context menu and select multiple items as usual.

Hold the left mouse button on an empty desktop area and drag a rectangle. Inside it, the original image is shown with the current crop; the effect continues outside. Release the button to restore the animation.

The rectangle works on the desktop, including while the wallpaper is manually paused. It is not shown in the editor preview or exported video. Start on an empty area: dragging an icon moves the file instead.

If desktop items are missing, check that file and launcher icons are enabled in XFCE desktop settings.
Откройте «Эффекты и система»: частота ка:
Open Effects and system: Frame rate sets the desired maximum. Economy mode caps it at 12 FPS; when the battery is discharging, FPS on battery applies too. For smooth 30 FPS, disable economy mode and select 30.

In Tools, automatic FPS adjustment lowers the rate when the CPU target is exceeded. If motion updates too rarely, check the CPU target. It is a percentage of one logical thread, not the entire processor, and is not a hard limit. GPU and compositor load are excluded.

The metrics below the preview describe wallpaper rendering on the selected monitor: renderer, actual FPS, CPU and RAM. They are not total application usage or video memory. Actual FPS can be below the setting because of limits or system performance.

To lower usage, reduce FPS, select one layer, increase character size and keep automatic pauses enabled when the desktop is hidden or the screen is locked. GPU usually reduces CPU work; the CPU fallback helps with driver problems.

Minimizing the editor stops its preview. Separate pause settings control the desktop wallpaper.
Профиль сохраняет картинку, символы, цве:
A profile saves the image, characters, colors, motion, crop and monitor settings. Configure the appearance, click Save profile and enter a name. Selecting a profile in the editor loads it into the preview; click Apply for the desktop.

Profiles store copies of the image and mask, so their original files can be moved. A saved profile named Matrix has its own image; the built-in Matrix — ready-made mode uses the currently selected image.

A custom character set stores only text and its mode: characters or phrases. The palette selector chooses ready-made colors; use a profile for the full appearance.

In Tools, export an appearance to a .mwp file with images and masks, then import it on another computer. If names collide, the import gets a separate name.

Selecting a profile from the system tray changes the wallpaper immediately. Profile transition sets how long the new appearance takes to appear.
Во вкладке «Эффекты и система» выберите:
In Effects and system, select Shared settings for monitors or a specific output, such as eDP-1 or HDMI-1. Subsequent changes apply to the selected entry.

Shared settings are used by screens without a separate appearance. For a specific screen, select it, choose its image and effect, then click Apply. Repeat for the next screen.

To remove a separate appearance, select the monitor, click Use shared settings, then Apply.

Settings are tied to the output name. They are retained when a monitor is disconnected and reused on reconnection.
Во вкладке «Инструменты» включите «Реаги:
In Tools, enable React to system playback and play music or a video. Volume changes brightness and bass changes speed. Audio comes from system playback; no microphone is needed.

Start with sensitivity 1 and reaction strength 0.10. Increase sensitivity for quiet music. Reduce the strength if the effect is too abrupt. A strength of 0 removes the reaction.

If there is no response, make sure audio is playing and check the message below the preview for audio analysis errors. Apply changes to update the desktop wallpaper. MP4 export creates a clip without an audio track.
Кнопка «Экспорт MP4…» создаёт ролик из т:
Export MP4 creates a clip from the current preview settings. Choose the file, duration, frame rate and resolution. You do not need to apply the appearance to the desktop first.

The video contains only the effect and image. Windows, icons, the cursor and the desktop selection rectangle are not recorded. There is no audio track.

Motion is adjusted for looping. In Gradually revealed mode, the image is already assembled in the export. In Appears and dissolves mode, the cycle is fitted to the video duration. The beginning of the clip may therefore differ from wallpaper startup.

1080p and high FPS take longer. Watch the progress; you can cancel the export. Cancelling leaves any existing destination file unchanged.
Сначала сохраните нужные профили. Во вкл:
Save the profiles you want to use first. In Tools, open Profile schedule, add entries and enable switching. Double-click a time or profile cell to edit it. Use HH:MM, for example 08:00 and 22:30. Click Save.

The schedule repeats daily using local time. The latest entry before the current time is applied, including the previous day. At 07:00, yesterday's 22:30 profile is active; at 08:00, the morning profile starts. Enabling the schedule may change the profile immediately.

Manual changes remain until the next schedule interval. Scheduling works while the wallpaper is running.

To start at login, enable the checkbox in Appearance and click Apply. Saving the schedule and manually pausing take effect immediately, without the main Apply button.
Изменения видны только справа: нажмите «:
Changes appear only on the right: click Apply to desktop. Selecting a profile or the Matrix mode in the editor changes the preview first.

Letters drift horizontally: Effects and system → Character movement → Stationary or Down. Stream direction is configured separately.

A setting seems to do nothing: the period needs cyclic reveal, depth needs multiple layers, subject detail needs a painted mask, music settings need audio reaction enabled, and the CPU target needs automatic FPS adjustment.

Motion has stopped: check Pause / Resume and the reason below the preview. The wallpaper may pause automatically when hidden or when the screen is locked. Very sparse motion may be due to low FPS or a low CPU target.

The image is dark: check brightness, contrast, colors and reveal mode. Try Always visible for comparison. For GPU issues, try CPU / Cairo in Tools.

The preview has stopped: change a setting to restart it. If an error is shown, address the reported cause. For missing icons, see Desktop files and selection.
Guide and parameter search — F1. Hover over settings to read tooltips.

Отдельные символы выбираются из введённо: Individual characters are picked from the entered alphabet. In words and phrases mode, write one phrase per line; spaces within phrases are kept.
Готовое сочетание цветов символов, фона: A ready-made combination of character, background and head colors. Their use depends on Color mode in Effects and system.
Загрузить сохранённое оформление в предп: Load a saved appearance into the preview. Click Apply to set it on the desktop.
Запускать обои при входе в сеанс. Измене: Start the wallpaper when you log in. The change is saved when you click Apply.
